title: S&P Considers Credit Downgrade for Nvidia
excerpt: Credit rating agency S&P is evaluating Nvidia for a potential credit downgrade to AA-, citing governance and key man risks.
body_html:
Credit rating agency S&P is considering lowering Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, which is the fourth-highest rating.

According to the agency, the potential downgrade is being evaluated due to governance concerns and key man risks.
